content: सभ्य {%a.%} [सभायां साधु यत्] .²1 Belonging to an assembly. .²2 Fit for society. .²3 Refined, polished, civilized. .²4 Well-bred, polite, civil, courteous; तस्मै सभ्याः सभार्याय गोप्त्रे गुप्ततमेन्द्रियाः <ls>R. 1. 55</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 29</ls>. .²5 Confidential, trusty, faithful. .{@-भ्यः@} .²1 An assessor. .²2 An assistant at an assembly. .²3 A person of honourable parentage; प्रायेणाल्पायुषः सभ्य कलावस्मिन् युगे जनाः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 1. 10</ls>. .²4 The keeper of a gaming-house. .²5 The servant of the keeper of a gaming-house. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the five sacred fires; सभ्यावसथ्यं चितयोऽसवो हि ते <ls>Bhāg. 3. 13. 37</ls>.
